post.title: Why is Christmas so expensive? The 12 Days cost $51,476
post.ig:
The Twelve Days of Christmas cost over $51,000.
PNC's 2025 Christmas Price Index hit $51,476.12, up 4.5% from 2024.
US holiday sales topped $1 trillion for the first time in 2025 (NRF).
UPS's residential peak surcharge went from 40 cents to 60 cents a package in late 2025, and Hopper's September 2026 index put Christmas round trips at $452, up 23%.
Sources: PNC, NRF, UPS, Hopper.
